player_prompt.intro:
Iwe mwini {player_id} ukukula mchezo wa Pig Dice.

Maloilo:
- Pa turn yako, ukhoza '[roll]' or '[hold]'
- Kujambula 2-6: Onjezera kwa turn total
- Kujambula 1: Kupha turn total na kumaliza turn
- Kukhala: Onjezera turn total ku zipata zako na kumaliza turn
- Mwini wa kwanza kufika {winning_score} zipata ndiyo wina

Pamene ndi turn yako, ukhoza kuwona zipata zozizwa na turn total.
Linda '[roll]' kujambula die or '[hold]' kukota zipata zako.

invalid_move.invalid_action: Mtundu wa kujambula usikuwa sawa. Tumia '[roll]' or '[hold]'.
